mathematical_change: Proved iterated original-coordinate Schur-pivot closure. If terminal residual has cap M_m and pivots are a_j, then M_0 <= 4^(1-2^-m) M_m^(2^-m) product_j |a_j|^(-2^-j), hence M_0 <= max(M_m,max_j 4/|a_j|). Applied the account02/B12 terminal cap to obtain unchanged constant when every |a_j| >= 8(sigma-delta)/(5e).
